name: SkillShooter
postStartCommand: pgrep -f 'skillshooter [s]erve' >/dev/null || (nohup ./skillshooter serve >> serve.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1 ; cat serve.log
postAttachCommand: pgrep -f 'skillshooter [s]erve' >/dev/null || (nohup ./skillshooter serve >> serve.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1 ; tail -1 serve.log
